school: 墨家/兼爱非攻/功利主义
representative_works: 《墨子》五十三篇（现存五十八篇，含《经上》《经下》《经说上》《经说下》《大取》《小取》等逻辑学与自然科学篇章）
historical_significance: 战国初期鲁国（一说宋国）人，墨家学派创始人，出身工匠阶层，精通技艺。其思想以兼爱为核心、以功利为价值标准、以天志明鬼为信仰支撑、以三表法为论证工具，构建了完整的实用主义哲学体系。墨家与儒家并称'显学'，是战国时期最具影响力的学派之一。墨家组织严密，有巨子制度，门徒众多，对战国政治影响深远。
core_thoughts: 兼爱交利法（无差等之爱）
三表法（实证检验方法论）
天志明鬼法（超越性权威建构）
非攻守成法（防御性和平主义）
尚贤任能法（唯才是举的阶级平等主张）
尚同一义法（层级组织整合）
节用厚生法（功利实用主义经济观）
节葬非乐法（礼俗改革批判）
非命立命法（反宿命论与能动性）
工具理性法（功利逻辑推理体系）
famous_quote: 兼相爱，交相利；利人乎即为，不利人乎即止；官无常贵，而民无终贱
influence: 墨家是战国显学之一，与儒家并称。墨家思想在秦汉后逐渐衰落，但兼爱非攻理念对后世和平主义、宗教团体（如太平道）影响深远。近代以来，墨家被重新发现，被视为中国科学精神与功利主义的源头，梁启超、胡适、谭嗣同等近代思想家对墨子评价极高。墨家逻辑学（墨辩）对中国古代逻辑学发展有开创性贡献。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以无差等的普遍之爱取代等级之爱，将爱与利统一起来。爱人不分亲疏贵贱，以利他实现互利，从根本上消解冲突根源。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Replacing hierarchical love with universal equal love; unifying love and benefit. Loving all people without distinction of kinship or status, achieving mutual benefit through other-regarding love.
process_zh: 识别冲突根源：一切乱起于'不相爱'
确立兼爱原则：打破亲疏贵贱等级界限
建立交利机制：爱人者人恒爱之，利人者人恒利之
实践验证：以实际福祉检验兼爱主张
制度化推广：将兼爱原则化为社会规范
process_en: Identify conflict roots: all disorder arises from 'not loving each other'
Establish universal love principle: break through kinship and status boundaries
Build mutual benefit mechanism: those who love others are loved in return
Practical verification: test universal love through real welfare outcomes
Institutional promotion: codify universal love as social norms

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以历史经验、民众听察、实际功效作为检验言论真理性的三个标准。本之于古者圣王之事，原之于百姓耳目之实，用之于国家百姓人民之利。这是墨家独特的实证主义认识论方法。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using three standards — historical experience, popular observation, and practical utility — to verify the truth of propositions. Grounded in ancient sage-kings' deeds, traced to common people's sensory experience, applied to national and public benefit.
process_zh: 提出主张：明确表述理论命题
历史检验：追溯是否有先例、是否符合历史经验（本之）
经验检验：考察是否符合民众直接感知（原之）
效用检验：付诸实践观察是否带来国家百姓之利（用之）
综合判断：三表皆合则为真
process_en: Propose proposition: clearly state the theoretical claim
Historical verification: trace precedent and historical consistency (ben zhi)
Empirical verification: assess alignment with popular sensory experience (yuan zhi)
Utility verification: implement and observe national/public benefit (yong zhi)
Synthetic judgment: all three criteria met confirms truth

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以天志为最高价值标准，以明鬼为赏善罚恶的保障机制。天有意志、好善恶恶，鬼神能赏贤罚暴。天志为兼爱非攻等墨家核心主张提供超越性权威。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Taking the Will of Heaven as the supreme axiological standard, with divine spirits as the guarantee for rewarding virtue and punishing vice. Heaven has will, loves righteousness and hates wickedness.
process_zh: 确立天志：天作为至高无上的价值标准
推演天意：天欲义恶不义，天兼爱万物
论证鬼神：通过历史与经验论证鬼神存在
建立奖惩：顺天意者得赏，逆天意者受罚
引导行为：以敬畏之心引导行义去恶
process_en: Establish Tianzhi: Heaven as supreme axiological standard
Deduce heavenly will: Heaven desires righteousness, loves all beings
Demonstrate spirits: prove spirit existence through history and experience
Create reward-punishment system: obedience rewarded, defiance punished
Guide conduct: inspire moral behavior through reverential awe

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 明确区分'攻'（侵略战争）与'守'（防御战争），坚决反对非正义侵略，全力援助被侵略者防御。墨子以实践行动（止楚攻宋）和系统守城技术构建防御性和平主义。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Clearly distinguishing attack from defense, firmly opposing unjust aggression while fully assisting the attacked in defense. Mohism builds a defensive peace doctrine through practical action and systematic siege defense technology.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《墨子·非攻》上中下；《墨子·公输》《墨子·备城门》等
process_zh: 战争定性：判断战争是攻还是守
价值判断：攻为不义，守为义举
实力建设：发展守城技术储备防御能力
主动干预：赴他所难援助被侵略者
止战目标：以守止攻最终消除攻战
process_en: War characterization: determine if war is aggression or defense
Moral judgment: aggression is unjust, defense is righteous
Capability building: develop siege defense technology
Active intervention: assist the aggrieved party
Peace objective: deter aggression through defense

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 官无常贵，而民无终贱——打破世袭贵族特权，以贤能为唯一标准选拔任用人才。代表了下层平民的政治诉求，是先秦最具革命性的政治平等主张。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Officials are not permanently noble and commoners are not forever lowly — breaking hereditary aristocratic privilege, selecting talent solely by merit and ability.
process_zh: 识别人才：不以门第论英雄，以贤能为标准
破除世袭：打破贵族垄断开放仕进通道
量能授官：依能力授予相应职位待遇
考核监督：以德能考核官员不称职者去之
制度保障：建立尚贤政治制度框架
process_en: Identify talent: judge by ability not by birth
Break hereditary monopoly: open official channels
Match position to ability: assign ranks by competence
Evaluate and supervise: remove unqualified officials
Institutional framework: build meritocratic system

thinking_modes.name_en: Identifying with the Superior Method (Shangtong Yiyi)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 选天下之贤可者立以为天子，通过逐级尚同建立统一的价值标准与政治秩序。下级服从上级最终统一于天子，天子又上同于天志。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Selecting the worthy from all under heaven to serve as Son of Heaven, establishing unified values and political order through hierarchical identification.
process_zh: 确立天子：选贤立天建立最高权威
层级尚同：地方意见逐级上报统一
同于天志：天子以天志为是非标准
政令统一：天志化为政令全国执行
赏罚保障：顺天意赏逆天意罚
process_en: Establish Son of Heaven: select worthy for supreme authority
Hierarchical identification: local opinions reported upward
Conform to Tianzhi: Son of Heaven takes heavenly will as standard
Unified edicts: heavenly will becomes nationwide policy
Reward-punishment guarantee: reward obedience punish defiance

thinking_modes.name_en: Frugality and Public Welfare Method (Jieyong Housheng)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 凡足以奉给民用则止——以实用价值为评判标准，批判一切无益于民生的浪费性消费。资源应用于改善民生而非享乐。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Whatever suffices to provide for the people's needs should suffice — using practical utility as the evaluation standard, critiquing all wasteful consumption that does not benefit the people.
process_zh: 需求识别：区分基本需求与奢侈欲望
效用评估：以国家百姓之利衡量一切支出
削减浪费：去除无用之费不必要之耗
厚生导向：资源用于改善民生
制度约束：制定节用标准规范社会消费
process_en: Need identification: distinguish basic needs from luxury desires
Utility assessment: measure all expenditure by national benefit
Eliminate waste: remove useless expenditure
Public welfare orientation: direct resources to livelihood
Institutional constraint: establish frugality standards

thinking_modes.name_en: Simple Burial and Anti-Music Method (Jiezang Feile)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以兴天下之利除天下之害为标准，批判厚葬久丧与奢侈音乐。丧葬应从简、音乐应废除——二者皆耗费资源而无益于民生。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using the promotion of universal benefit and elimination of universal harm as the standard, critiquing elaborate burial, prolonged mourning, and luxurious music.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《墨子·节葬》下；《墨子·非乐》上中下
process_zh: 成本评估：计算厚葬久丧的经济与社会成本
效用检验：音乐是否有实际民生效用
替代方案：提出节葬短丧去乐的改革方案
利益比较：以民生福祉对比传统礼仪
制度革新：推动丧葬与礼乐制度改革
process_en: Cost assessment: calculate economic and social costs of elaborate burial
Utility test: determine if music has practical livelihood benefit
Alternative proposals: advocate simple funeral and shortened mourning
Benefit comparison: weigh livelihood against traditional ritual
Institutional innovation: reform funeral and music systems

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 批判命定论，主张强必治不强必乱——命运掌握在人的努力之中而非先天注定。这是对消极宿命论的有力反驳，强调主观能动性与个人责任。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Critiquing fatalism, asserting that strength brings order while weakness brings chaos — fate is in human effort not predestined.
process_zh: 识别命论：警惕'命已定矣'的消极论调
批判论证：命定论导致惰政废业天下大乱
立命主张：治乱在人为非关天命
激励努力：强力从事强本节用方能有功
承担责任：个人命运掌握在自己手中
process_en: Identify fatalism:警惕命已定矣消极论调
Critical argument: fatalism leads to idle governance and chaos
Anti-fatalist proposition: order and chaos depend on human effort
Encourage exertion: strong work and frugality yield results
Accept responsibility: one's fate is in one's own hands

thinking_modes.name_en: Instrumental Rationality Method (Gongju Li Xing Fa)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以功用为最高判断标准，一切思想制度行为必须以实际效果检验。运用故、理、类三物论法进行逻辑推理，发展出中国古代最系统的逻辑学体系。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using utility as the supreme evaluative standard; all thought, institutions and actions must be tested by practical results. Employing cause (gu), principle (li), and analogy (lei) for logical reasoning.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《墨子·经上》《经下》《经说上》《经说下》《大取》《小取》
process_zh: 效果预设：明确行动的预期效用目标
路径设计：以最小成本实现最大效用
逻辑验证：运用三物论法检验论证有效性
实效检验：实践效果验证理论正确性
工具优化：不断改进技术手段提高效用
process_en: Utility presupposition: clarify expected outcome goals
Path design: achieve maximum utility with minimum cost
Logical verification: test argument validity through three categories
Practical verification: validate theory through real-world results
Tool optimization: continuously improve techniques
